sql_templates.name: VCP Breakouts
sql_templates.template:
SELECT e.symbol, e.trade_date, e.close, s.stage, v.vcp_score 
FROM market.equity_eod e 
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON e.symbol = s.symbol AND e.trade_date = s.snapshot_date 
JOIN scores.stage2_vcp_picks v ON e.symbol = v.symbol 
WHERE e.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod) 
AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
AND v.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks) 
AND e.close >= e.week52_high 
AND s.stage = 'STAGE_2' 
ORDER BY v.vcp_score DESC 
LIMIT 10

synthesis_guidance: ['Prioritize stocks with the highest VCP scores and STAGE_2.', 'Report anomalies in scores or data, especially around high liquidity and new highs.']
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 1668

sql_templates.description: Identify winning and losing signals with their outcomes and motivations.
sql_templates.sql:
SELECT s.symbol, s.sector, s.company, s.signal, s.date_issued, s.date_resolved, 
                   s.price_at_issue, s.price_at_resolution, s.return_pct, s.hit_target, s.hit_stop,
                   ss.stage, ss.technical_score, ss.investment_score
            FROM signals.signal_log s
            JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON s.symbol = ss.symbol 
            WHERE s.date_resolved IS NOT NULL 
            AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)

SELECT s.sector, COUNT(s.id) AS signals_issued, 
                   SUM(CASE WHEN s.hit_target THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS targets_hit,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN s.hit_stop THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stops_hit
            FROM signals.signal_log s
            WHERE s.date_resolved IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY s.sector
            ORDER BY targets_hit DESC

synthesis_guidance: ['Summarize key patterns observed in successful and failing signals.', 'Identify areas for skill improvement based on past performance.', 'Propose next steps or checks based on the analysis.']
title: Signal Outcome Feedback Review Variant 1677
